label: A2 alternate possible-impossibility…: A2P2B asks whether a situation that can be impossible is…
definition: A2P2B asks whether a situation that can be impossible is actually impossible. Its impossible title attributes mean contradicting something necessary. A2C2 recalls the affirmative report, then uses contraposition and possibility/impossibility duality to say a possible situation cannot be impossible and therefore is necessarily possible. This is a source reading of a reported conditional and its proposed interpretation, not a proof of a modal frame axiom.
note: The question alone asserts no answer. Actual here concerns whether the situation is impossible, not an actual concrete cause or a rigid individual. The original A2P2 individual-possibility invariance report is not silently identified with this differently worded input; the source reaches the same named modal principle by a separate paragraph. Declaration-completion audit (2026-11-09): original sense remains OPEN: selected situation/formula scope, actual standpoint, modality and a bridge from contradicting something necessary to Kripke Box(not P) are not fixed by this gloss. The separate analyst profile in TruthCore.Modal.PossibleImpossibility proves only a conditional formula-local duality certificate. It is not this original sense and does not clear its allowance. A2 retains its reported contraposition interpretation; A10 retains only the narrower input and its differently worded C2 recall.
